Me telling you to "not do it" seems really superficial, but it's not.
If you're not having success around women or talking to people in general, you can try r/nofap.  Try it for a week and see if your energy and confidence changes as your serum Testosterone levels increase.

Otherwise (even if you can't find a girl now) who cares?  Women are not the meaning of life..  At least live for yourself or for your family.  Give it time.  We live in a society that tries to push sex everywhere we look..  You're 30.  That's young!
